references.text: In Genesis 46:13, the sons of Issachar are mentioned, including Jashub (Jov) and Shimron, who are the ancestors of the clans listed here in Numbers 26:24.
First Chronicles 7:1 lists the sons of Issachar, including Jashub and Shimron, corresponding to the clans mentioned in this verse.
The first census of the tribe of Issachar in Numbers 1:28-29, upon which this second census in chapter 26 builds.
